name: PharmaLLM - Knowledge Gap Auto-Fill v2 (with Resolution Check)

nodes.name: Knowledge Gap Webhook
nodes.notes:
Receives POST from PharmaLLM gap-detector.
Expects: gap_id, original_query, search_topic, timestamp, gemma_response, reason

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gemma2:9b', prompt: 'Generate 3 different web search queries to find information about: ' + $json.body.search_topic + '\nOriginal question was: ' + $json.body.original_query + '\nReturn ONLY a JSON array of 3 search query strings, nothing else. Example: ["query 1", "query 2", "query 3"]', stream: false }) }}

nodes.name: Generate Search Queries (Ollama)
nodes.notes: Calls Ollama to generate 3 search queries based on the knowledge gap topic.

nodes.name: Parse Search Queries
nodes.notes: Parses Ollama response into individual query items (up to 3).

nodes.name: Search SearXNG
nodes.notes: Searches SearXNG for each query. Runs once per query (up to 3 times).

nodes.name: Deduplicate Results
nodes.notes: Collects top 3 results per query, deduplicates by URL. Outputs up to 9 unique URLs.

nodes.name: Fetch Page Content
nodes.notes: Fetches each page as text. ContinueOnFail so one bad URL doesn't stop the flow.

nodes.name: Truncate & Clean Content
nodes.notes: Strips HTML, truncates to 8000 chars, filters out failed fetches and error pages.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gemma2:9b', prompt: 'You are a knowledge extraction assistant. Given this web page content, extract the key facts and information relevant to this topic: ' + $json.search_topic + '

Web content:
' + $json.page_content.slice(0, 6000) + '

Return a clean, factual summary in 2-4 paragraphs. If the content is not relevant to the topic, respond with exactly NOT_RELEVANT and nothing else: no explanation.', stream: false, relevance: { topic: $json.search_topic, page: $json.page_content.slice(0, 6000), url: $json.url } }) }}

nodes.name: Extract Knowledge (Ollama)
nodes.notes: Calls Ollama to extract relevant knowledge from each page. Filters irrelevant content.

nodes.name: Filter Relevant Only
nodes.notes: Removes NOT_RELEVANT responses and errors. Only passes through useful summaries.

nodes.name: Store in Knowledge Base
nodes.notes: Stores each relevant summary into PharmaLLM knowledge base via the ingest-text API.

nodes.name: Summary & Log
nodes.notes: Aggregates stats: pages fetched, relevant pages, chunks stored. Passes gap_id forward.

nodes.name: Check Gap Resolution
nodes.notes: After ingesting new content, re-asks the original question through the full RAG pipeline and checks if the gap is now resolved. Updates gap_log.db status to 'resolved' or 'unresolved'.

nodes.name: Resolution Result Log
nodes.notes: Final node: logs whether the knowledge gap was resolved after ingesting new content.

nodes.name: SearXNG Error Handler
nodes.notes: Handles SearXNG failures gracefully — logs and stops.

nodes.name: Ollama Query Error Handler
nodes.notes: If Ollama fails to generate queries, falls back to using the search_topic directly.

nodes.name: Anything Relevant?
nodes.notes: Filter Relevant Only sets `error` when nothing relevant was found: store the facts, or record the gap as unresolved.

nodes.name: Mark Gap Unresolved
nodes.notes: Nothing relevant was found: record the attempt as unresolved without spending a 27B re-answer.
